name: burrow-core
description: Burrow identity and shared services for the Go IDE. First built-in extension — proves the layer-4 path (see ../../patches/README.md).

burrow.inspector.hideStockVariables.markdownDescription: Hide the stock **Variables** view while debugging Go — the Burrow Go inspector (Miller columns + value pane) replaces it. Set to `false` to bring the stock Variables tree back alongside the inspector.

burrow.inspector.hideStockWatch.markdownDescription: Hide the stock **Watch** view while debugging Go — the Burrow Watch view (same summary renderer + value pane) replaces it. Set to `false` to bring the stock Watch view back alongside it.
